      "name": "docs",

      "evidence": "Release notes update follows from the mempool feature removal.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release note changes that accompany code changes belong to the area being changed."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/mempool_options.h and src/kernel/mempool_removal_reason.* to delete expiry options and removal reasons.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Modifications in kernel headers simply propagate the deletion of the mempool expiry setting and do not alter the kernel boundary or public library architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mempool label and deletes age-based transaction expiry and the entry_time multi-index container from CTxMemPool.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Eliminating age-based expiry prevents dropping transactions that could still be mined and reduces mempool overhead by removing an entire multi-index container. The author notes that age eviction 'is incentive-incompatible: it may drop transactions that could still be mined' and that removing the index drops per-entry dynamic memory usage from three indexes to two."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches functional tests and fuzz files to remove expiry tests and references.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Changes to functional tests and fuzz harnesses merely adapt tests to the removal of mempool expiry rather than modifying testing infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp to warn on the deprecated -mempoolexpiry configuration argument.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deprecating an option specific to mempool behavior belongs to the mempool category rather than general node utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp and headers to remove expiry parameter propagation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits in validation files are passthroughs for mempool options and do not alter consensus or validation behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches wallet_resendwallettransactions.py to adapt eviction testing away from expiry.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Updating a functional wallet test to test resubmission via replacement rather than expiry is purely consequential to the mempool change."
    }
  ],
